create_CMakeExtension: create a CMakeExtension instance to define a C/C++ extension module built with CMake
build_CMakeBuildExt: build a CMakeBuildExt setuptools command class that compiles C/C++ extensions via CMake
configure_CMakeBuildExt: configure CMakeBuildExt to set build type, output directories, and Python executable path
run_setup_install: run the setup script to install the spiral package with TensorFlow and dm-sonnet dependencies
test_CMakeBuildExt: test CMakeBuildExt verifies CMake is available and builds extensions in Debug or Release mode
